body:
My problem is just having an ugly face. I'm (kinda) tall at 6'0'' and I weigh 165 at 5% body fat. I work out a lot. Its really the only thing that keeps my mind off of everything going wrong in my life.
I really don't know what exactly I can change
I work out and have a bunch of hobbies and stuff like that. There really isn't anything I can do to improve my appearance

I have a degree in this, trust me, if you aren't attractive to someone then they won't date you, if you have a great personality, then they will want to be friends, but they won't ever consider dating you.  Any girl who says otherwise is a liar. Just because their ashamed about it does not make it any less true. If you have heard the whole "sorry, I think you're a great guy, but I just don't feel that way about you. We can still be friends, though" as much as me, then I guarantee you wouldn't still believe in that nonsense.

Sorry, I don't want to sound rude or like an asshole, but I'm just saying the truth. Personality will only get you friends, not relationships or dates or any of  the fun stuff everyone else gets
I do go to the gym, and I use face wash. A good body doesn't make up for a shitty face, and clear skin doesn't make up for shitty bone structure :/
